scope: Exploratory authorized full-compatible-source extension: T1 CRISPRi core plus all 7 usable KO units, 12 contexts, 5 study/lineage votes, 34 panel targets. Does not close D-053.
band_interpretation: Hypothesis, not a confidence interval; no independent KO validation yet.

readout_rule.delta_above_0.005: Promising package-level single-run observation; no source-level attribution or stable promotion without independent replication.
readout_rule.delta_within_plus_minus_0.005: Inconclusive against t36; added coverage does not establish improvement.
readout_rule.delta_below_minus_0.005: Unfavorable extended package; retain t36 reference and examine per-member and KO diagnostics without retuning this frozen run.

member_predictions.PDS: Uncertain; expect small change because only 34 target rows change; uncentered common KO response may dilute specificity.
member_predictions.NMAE: Uncertain sign; KO magnitude may differ from CRISPRi despite fixed weak source weight.
member_predictions.REACH: Uncertain sign; additional observed responses could help coverage or add context-specific responses.
member_predictions.FID: Uncertain sign; generator unchanged, but response means change on KO-supported rows.
member_predictions.JAC: Uncertain sign; weak new votes can alter significance near thresholds.
member_predictions.MSE: Expect the scaled member to remain near the t36 value zero; this is a hypothesis, not permission to impute a missing official result.

scientific_changes: KO matched-control shrunk effects enter without panel centering, avoiding singleton cancellation.
Within-study/lineage contexts use reliability-weighted averages; study reliability is maximum context reliability, preventing vote multiplication.
Each of five KO study votes has fixed weight 0.25; no selection against observed new effects or validation results.
CRISPRi core recipe, amplitude 1.576 and cis unchanged; no CRISPRa sign reversal.
technical_gate: no target changes outside KO support
submitter: DATI-TRANSFER only; Lead delegated new candidate and retains T1/t37 block
